newsitem.title: USA: Drew Industries acquires Pritt Tire and Axle.
newsitem.headline: Drew Industries acquires Pritt Tire and Axle.

text.p: Drew Industries Inc said Tuesday that its subsidiary, Shoals Supply Inc, acquired the assets and business of Pritt Tire and Axle Inc of Bristol, Ind.
The purchase price included $4,450,000 in cash and a three year warrant to purchase 40,000 shares of the common stock of Drew at $11.00 per share.
Drew said the acquisition is accretive to its earnings.
Pritt, which refurbishes axles and tires used in the transportation of manufactured homes, will be operated as an additional branch of Shoals, Drew said.
Pritt sales for 1996 were $10.7 million, Drew said.
This acquisition furthers Drew's goal to expand Shoals' territory from a southeast regional manufacturer to a national manufacturer, Drew said.
